description: This file defines the ModelRecord class, which models a record within a data file in the Ofbiz framework. It includes properties such as name, type code, description, parent/child relationships, and a list of fields that compose the record.

classes.name: ModelRecord
classes.description: Represents a record model within the framework, encapsulating its identity, type information, hierarchy, description, and constituent fields.

methods.name: getModelField
methods.description: Retrieves a specific ModelField object from the record's list of fields by name.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the record.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the record.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the record.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the record.

methods.name: getParentName
methods.description: Returns the name of the parent record, if any.

methods.name: setParentName
methods.description: Sets the name of the parent record.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns the list of fields that compose this record.

methods.name: setFields
methods.description: Replaces the list of fields for this record.

methods.name: getTypeCode
methods.description: Returns the type code of the record.

methods.name: setTypeCode
methods.description: Sets the type code of the record.

methods.name: getTcPosition
methods.description: Returns the position of the type-code within the record.

methods.name: setTcPosition
methods.description: Sets the position of the type-code.

methods.name: setTcMin
methods.description: Sets the minimum type-code.

methods.name: setTcMax
methods.description: Sets the maximum type-code.

methods.name: setTcIsNum
methods.description: Specifies whether the type-code comparison is numerical.

methods.name: getTcMin
methods.description: Returns the minimum type-code.

methods.name: getTcMax
methods.description: Returns the maximum type-code.

methods.name: getTcLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the type-code.

methods.name: setTcLength
methods.description: Sets the length of the type-code.

methods.name: setLimit
methods.description: Sets the record's limit on the number of child records.

methods.name: getParentRecord
methods.description: Returns the parent ModelRecord object.

methods.name: getChildRecords
methods.description: Returns the list of child ModelRecord objects.

methods.name: setParentRecord
methods.description: Sets the parent ModelRecord object.
